shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6: sky level above, solid rock basement below, fully simulated linked maps with live see-through air, cross-level work/hauling/medical/power/pipes/climate, stairs/ladders/elevators, opt-in vertical threats, caravan/trade/launch world integration, one-colony UI.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: one sky level above, the surface, one basement below. Every level is a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky level with a live view of the surface below; (2) performance via caching, event-driven work, and zero recurring cost when idle.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony only. DBH + VEF PipeSystem soft compat; Reverse Commands soft compat (reflection-only).
- Cap: 3 levels per column. Basement solid mineable rock, thick-roofed, 12C.
- Animal policy (conservative): pets follow master, obedient pets get send gizmos, non-pen unrestricted pets cross for food; pen animals never.
- Robustness: ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- ALL vertical links are IMMORTAL (useHitPoints false, Flammability 0, no MaxHitPoints; round-12): raid trash AI was bashing the only player buildings on pocket levels instead of using them. Removal = per-building Remove gizmo (vanilla deconstruct icon, designates normal deconstruction, refunds; removes both ends) or the architect deconstruct tool.

## Vertical transport
- Stairs (1x), ladder (1.6x), grand staircase 2x2 (0.6x, quality scales climb), elevator (0.35x, power bridge, Extend gizmos, two-hop rides).
- Climb = 90t x type x quality x slider. All minifiable (uninstall collapses far side). Bomb >= 40 punches constructed rooftops. Giddy-Up mounted riders blocked.
- Stairs do NOT unroof anything below. Sky-side landing platforms (footprint+1) are RoofSurface, exempt from air-reversion while stairs stand.
- T9 VERTICAL UTILITY LINKS (Building_ABUtilityLink, ext utilityOnly): full counterpart lifecycle, never pawns (excluded inside NearestUsableStairs), no float menu, no climate exchange. AB_VerticalConduitUp/Down (Power tab, Electricity, CompABPowerBridge); AB_VerticalWaterPipeUp/Down (DBH patch-gated, Hygiene tab, research mirrors DBH). ABPipeCompat routes per-def flags; VEF nets remain stairs-bridged.

## Sky surface model (round-10 final)
- Owned terrains: AB_OpenAir, AB_RoofSurface, AB_MountainTop. COVERED-BELOW rule (LevelSync.CoveredBelow) with 8-neighbor re-sync; wall-only changes converge on the 2000t sweep.
- Mountain cap: vanilla fog material clones, overlap-free 3x3 tiling, two runtime queues; mined floors fill in source rock edge color (TryGetMinedRockColor).
- Sync self-heal: subscription retry (250t) + ReconcileRooftops; natural roofs generation-time only.

## See-below renderer (round-12 lighting model)
- Static pass: lower map's section meshes via cloned materials in a runtime-derived queue band under the measured terrain queue.
- WATER (round 12): SectionLayer_Watergen EXCLUDED from the below pass (depth layer requires vanilla's WaterDepth subcamera; flat-drawn it painted black slabs over rivers). Water-shader materials are shader-swapped in BelowMaterialFor to TerrainHard keeping mainTexture (solid water-blue SolidColor fallback) because water shaders sample the CURRENT map's global flow buffers and render black cross-map.
- MASK (round 12): fog-of-war opacity (unexplored surface hidden) + constant baseDim slider ONLY. All light-based darkening REMOVED - the sky map's own day-night dimming reaches the below meshes through shared shader globals, and stacking a light mask read near-black at night (regression report).
- Dynamic pass: ONE-WAY MIRROR (unroofed, unfogged, in view, under open air). Ceiling hints; far clip 70. Weather decider suppressed on pocket levels.

## Systems (T0-T10 verified in-game 2026-07-19)
- Logistics: outbound haul + inbound fetch + demand pull + export pinning + carried-cargo delivery. Column-aware stuff picker.
- Needs: rest/food across column. Medical rescue three ways: auto work-giver, emergency work migration (pre-check before cooldown, 600t), assignment-free forced float-menu rescue (verified). Capture via float menu. CarriedIntent through StairTransfer.
- One-colony UI: tables append other levels; colonist bar per column; level buttons; camera preserved; beds alert aggregated.
- Power/pipes/climate bridges per link; ABPendingOrders replay (also caravan joins).

## T8 threat opt-ins
- Divert already-fired surface incidents; pacing/points vanilla. Toggles default OFF + chance slider.
- Infestations -> basement (round-12 rework): CanFireNowSub postfix lets the incident FIRE when only the basement qualifies (mountainless surfaces rejected it outright - playtest BUG2); TryExecuteWorker prefix diverts on roll OR ALWAYS when the surface has no valid cell. Eligibility = settings + basement alive + insects faction + basement hive cap + TryFindCell(basement); deterministic, roll only at execution.
- Drop raids -> sky: prefix on TryResolveRaidSpawnCenter of the four drop arrival workers; skips quest raids, preset centers, sieges, non-hostiles; validates drop room.
- HOSTILE DESCEND AI (guard hostileMove): 250t pocket scan behind any-hostiles gate; idle humanlike/mech hostiles with no reachable target take stairs toward ground; IsIdle also treats attack jobs TARGETING a link building as idle (immortal stairs = pointless bashing, round 12); StairTransfer releases the map-scoped lord and joins/creates LordJob_AssaultColony on arrival. Insects never cross.

## T11 world integration
- Settings: columnWealth (ON), worldIntegration (ON). Guard: world.
- TILE IDENTITY: WorldObject.Tile postfix gives our PocketMapParents the ground tile (Valid-check first for hot-path cost); launches/range/trader distance work from any level.
- COLUMN WEALTH: ground-map storyteller getters aggregate linked levels (vanilla home formula); skipped in fixedWealthMode; no double count (vanilla redirects pocket targets to sourceMap).
- CARAVANS: AllSendablePawns lists column free colonists (plain calls only); StartFormingCaravan trims off-surface picks, stairs ride + ABPendingOrders join into the forming lord; all-off-surface rejected with message.
- TRADE: beacon listings column-wide; debt settlement drains level by level; pocket consoles hail surface passing ships; purchases drop at surface.
- SETTLEMENT LOSS: vanilla semantics + column-colonist confirmation dialog; pocket maps die with the ground map natively (destroyOnParentMapAbandoned, explicit in defs).

## Performance architecture
- ABGuard plain-bool switches; AnySkyLevels gate; NearestUsableStairsCached memo. Recurring: weather 150t, pipes/climate 250t, power 10t hash, rooftop sweep 2000t, hostile scan 250t pocket-only. Zero recurring cost with no levels. Mask rebuild no longer samples glow grids (fog + constant only).

## Compat
- DBH + VEF bridges; Reverse Commands; Fluffy Animal Tab; Declutter UI; Giddy-Up; incompatibleWith MultiFloors + ZLevels1.1; RimThreaded unsupported; foreign pocket maps read as level-0.

## Documented accepted limitations
- Floating rim/cap cells on natural roof loss (rare); sky projectile dim; tall below-sprites clip at rooftop edges; wall-only edits converge on sweep; mined-floor hard tint edges; bill radius vs stairs delivery; couples as singles in beds alert; RC direct links only; restaurants per-level; stuff picker direct links only; doctor pile-on window.
- Below-view water is still and depth-flat by design (no cross-map flow animation possible).
- T8: fleeing/kidnapping raiders exit only via descend; mounted Giddy-Up raiders never descend; basement insects do not resurface; basement infestations need some mined-out space (TryFindCell scores real cells).
- T9: VEF nets bridge at stairs only; vertical links can open a level like stairs.
- T11: caravan items surface-only; animals/prisoners not listed cross-level; purchases drop at surface; transporter loading surface-only; Odyssey gravship interactions unsupported/untested.

## Tranche plan
- T0-T10 DONE + verified. T8 + T9 + T11 implemented; playtest round 12 found: darkness regression (FIXED: mask light term removed), black water (FIXED: Watergen excluded + shader swap), raiders bashing stairs (FIXED: immortal links + remove gizmo + idle-attack backstop), basement infestation never firing (FIXED: CanFireNow postfix + forced divert). All pending relaunch verification.
- Next: verification relaunch, then T5 publishing prep. Backlog: VEF per-net shafts, caravan items/animals cross-level.

## Status
Round-12 fixes implemented and compiling: see-below lighting flattened (fog + slider only), water readable, immortal links with Remove gizmo, infestation fires on basement-only colonies. Awaiting relaunch.
